metric: Class I mutant HLA binders (IC50 <=500 nM), all 80 patients
Tier A: HLA binder + rank <=0.01 + mutant-only HLA binder
Tier B: HLA binder + rank <=0.01, excluding tier A

Tier C: HLA binder + rank <=0.05 but not <=0.01
Tier D: HLA binder without rank <=0.05
Tier E: weak HLA binder with rank <=0.01
Tier F: weak HLA binder without rank <=0.01
